title: What If Daylight Saving Time Never Ended?

scenes.text: What if daylight saving time never ended? America tried it once, and quit within a year.
In January 1974, clocks moved ahead and stayed there, saving an estimated 100,000 barrels of oil a day.
But winter sunrise slid past 8 a.m. in many places, so children walked to school in the dark.
Support collapsed from 79 percent in December 1973 to just 42 percent by February.
Sleep doctors say clocks that drift away from the sun leave body clocks out of step.
Congress restored winter standard time that same year. Today sleep doctors favor permanent standard time instead.

description:
What if daylight saving time never ended?
America ran the experiment in 1974. Dark winter mornings ended it in under a year.
What should we run through next?
first_comment: Would you rather have dark mornings or dark evenings? Share your own what-if.
